description: Two four-quadrant multipliers, each working out A times B plus C, with a voltage-controlled offset

params.text: Attenuates and inverts the B input of that section before it multiplies A, from x-2 through zero to x2
Attenuates and inverts the C input of that section before it is added, from x-1 through zero to x1

inputs.text: One factor of the multiplication in that section; it is multiplied by B and divided by 5V
The other factor of the multiplication in that section, scaled by the B level knob; with nothing patched it stands at 5V, which turns the knob into a plain attenuverter for A
The offset added to the product in that section, scaled by the C level knob; with nothing patched it stands at 10V, which turns the knob into an offset control

outputs.text: The first section's result, clipped; with no cable here that result is passed on and added into OUT 2 instead
The second section's result, clipped, with the first section's result added in when OUT 1 has no cable

notes: both level knobs of a section come up at their centre, where they pass nothing, so that section's output stays at 0V until one of them is turned off centre.
